text: Computer Vision is a field of artificial intelligence that enables computers to see and understand the world through images and videos. At its core, it involves two main tasks: image recognition, which identifies what an object is (like a cat or a car), and object detection, which locates where that object is in a picture. These abilities have many practical applications. For example, in healthcare, computer vision helps doctors analyze X-rays, while in retail, it power features like automated checkout. Perhaps the most exciting use is in self-driving cars, where the system constantly detects pedestrians, traffic signs, and other vehicles to navigate safely. As this technology improves, it continues to change how we interact with our environment.
